description: This file defines constants and functions for handling bundled plugin paths, including directory paths and file glob patterns, as well as utility functions to construct specific plugin file paths and URLs.

methods.name: bundledPluginRoot
methods.description: Returns the root path for a plugin given its ID.

methods.name: bundledPluginFile
methods.description: Returns the full path for a plugin file given its ID and relative path.

methods.name: bundledDistPluginRoot
methods.description: Returns the distribution directory path for a plugin.

methods.name: bundledDistPluginFile
methods.description: Returns the full distribution file path for a plugin given its ID and relative path.

methods.name: bundledPluginCallsite
methods.description: Constructs a string combining the plugin file path and a line number, likely for referencing a specific callsite in code.
